sahneler.metin: On a stormy night, a schooner rammed the steamer Lady Elgin.
Within half an hour, hundreds of people were dead.
The schooner had struck it near the paddlewheel.
Survivors clung to wreckage in the storm.
Many were lost in the surf near shore.
It pushed for stronger navigation-light rules on the Great Lakes.

aciklama:
Lady Elgin sank on Lake Michigan after a collision. The cause: collision punching a hole below the paddlewheel, with rapid flooding.
